name: Before & After
description: Compare two photos with a slider you drag, side by side or stacked, with your own labels. Great for makeovers, workouts and renovations.
prompt: A before and after photo comparer with a draggable slider, side by side and stacked layouts, editable labels, and saving the comparison as an image.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Compara dos fotos con un deslizador, lado a lado o una encima de otra, con tus propias etiquetas. Ideal para cambios de look, entrenamientos y reformas.
